headline: Microsoft's October Windows Server update breaks Exchange sign-in, mail flow
summary: Microsoft confirmed that this month's Windows Server security updates are breaking OWA sign-in and mail delivery on some Exchange Server systems, with admins reporting backed-up email queues. One report attributes the cause to the security updates themselves, another to a changed server default, and an admin described spending an entire weekend fixing affected servers.
